title: Post Ban Metagame Analysis
author: Den
meta_overview: 7 bans target Draven and Miracle builds to promote more interaction. Draven loses champion, OGN-168, and battlefields — Miracle and Detonate builds dead, only Midrange survives. Irelia and Ezreal predicted as new Chaos frontrunners. Body domain (Master Yi, Fiora, Jax, Sett, Lucian) expected to rise. Control legends may paradoxically struggle more.
banned_cards: OGN-168 (staple in all Draven archetypes + Irelia)
OGN-292 (battlefield — also used by Fiora, Sett, Jax draw engines)
SFD-122 (draw card — big loss for Ezreal and Sivir/MF)
key_predictions: Midrange Draven still viable but weaker — Miracle and Detonate builds dead
Ezreal predicted as best Chaos legend (relative standpoint, doesn't share Draven's domains)
Irelia strongest in raw power — OGS-011 replaces OGN-168, but will be targeted
Annie easiest time adapting — core gameplan unchanged, but weakest of top 3 Chaos
Body domain rises: Master Yi, Fiora, Jax, Sett, Lucian all benefit
Fiora/Sett/Jax must replace banned OGN-292 — OGN-280 as replacement
Control legends may struggle MORE — Irelia/Ezreal harder to exhaust than Draven
Viktor and Azir best Order legends (proactive arsenal)
Kai'Sa and Lux hurt by slower meta paradox — more turns but harder to control
SFD-105 expected to increase in popularity

draven_replacements.battlefields: OGN-290 (synergy with new champion), OGN-294 (vs spell opponents)

chaos_domain_impact.Irelia: Lost OGN-168 + 2 battlefields, but OGS-011 mitigates. Still strong.
chaos_domain_impact.Ezreal: Only lost SFD-122. Best positioned if Draven weakens.
chaos_domain_impact.Annie: Lost OGN-292/OGN-182 draw, but OGN-201 available. Core plan intact.
chaos_domain_impact.Sivir: Can't play Miracle anymore. OGN-160 build also lost key cards.
chaos_domain_impact.Miss Fortune: Same as Sivir — Miracle dead, Aurora build weakened.
chaos_domain_impact.Teemo: Relied on Miracle build — will struggle.
chaos_domain_impact.Jinx: Relied on Miracle build — will struggle.
